Returns the number of participants for a given entity (GLOBAL, ECOSYSTEM, CREDENTIAL_SCHEMA, or PARTICIPANT) and role type at the block selected by the At-Block-Height header (or the latest indexed block when omitted), based on the entity_participant_changes log.
